misc.title: #ONEPIECE1189 The first round ended in disaster for both Luffy and Loki. However, we know Loki will return with his Awakening or hybrid form. As for Luffy, I can imagine his fruit getting an upgrade,
misc.text: #ONEPIECE1189 The first round ended in disaster for both Luffy and Loki. However, we know Loki will return with his Awakening or hybrid form. As for Luffy, I can imagine his fruit getting an upgrade, or the "Voice of All Things" playing a role, as was already teased in Chapter 1151. The most important thing is that both of them fight TOGETHER, rather than making the mistake of fighting one-on-one like in the first round. They need to start the way they did against Gunko; I also think that once Gaban is defeated, Luffy and Loki will return together and both fight against Imu.
